faq.q: What is a titanium anode basket bottom plate?
faq.a: A titanium anode basket bottom plate is a precision-machined anode system component used in double-layer micro-perforated anode basket bottom. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium anode basket bottom plate?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate is designed for double-layer micro-perforated anode basket bottom. The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium anode basket bottom plate manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Anode Basket Bottom Plate is manufactured using Expanded mesh forming. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium anode basket bottom plate?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium anode basket bottom plate?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
